issues.explanation: The diff adds five production classes plus a migration and policy changes but ships zero Pest/PHPUnit tests, violating the TDD convention that every feature ships with a test.
CreateQueue and UpdateQueue each define an identical private isUniqueViolation helper instead of reusing one.
QueueAccessFactory::configure runs afterMaking with a membership save, so factory make (non-persistent) can unexpectedly write to the database.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes via app/Actions with Gate authorization (CreateQueue.php:60, UpdateQueue.php:223, SetQueueAccess.php:140); QueuePolicy for all abilities; reversible migration with down() (migration:640-643); #[Fillable] on QueueAccess.php:364; audit channel logging (SetQueueAccess.php:178,192); docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG Added section updated

readability.evidence: Small focused actions (CreateQueue.php:58, UpdateQueue.php:216, SetQueueAccess.php:134), clear names (isManagerOf, isUniqueViolation), sibling #[Fillable]/casts style, explanatory factory comment

requirements.evidence: CreateQueue.php:62-83 trim/slugify/unique-within-entity plus QueryException->ValidationException; UpdateQueue.php:227-253 nullable attrs with ignore-own-slug plus race mapping; SetQueueAccess.php:142-192 same-entity check, Rule::in validation, upsert-or-delete with conditional audit log; QueuePolicy.php:508-536 manager-always plus employee-grant with is_array deny; CallNextTicket.php:31 and Ticket.php:439-444 lock->inactive->authorize->LogicException order; docs and CHANGELOG updated

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the task (actions, enum, model, policy, factory, queue_access migration, Ticket/CallNextTicket authorization, docs, CHANGELOG); no delete action and no Livewire/HTTP additions

security.evidence: Gate::forUser authorize before writes in CreateQueue.php:60, UpdateQueue.php:223, SetQueueAccess.php:140, CallNextTicket.php:31 and Ticket.php:444; Validator in all actions; is_array permissions check in QueuePolicy.php:535; no unescaped output or mass-assignment gap

simplicity.evidence: Lean actions reusing Str/Gate/Validator/Rule::unique and existing relations; only duplication is the identical isUniqueViolation helper in CreateQueue.php:96 and UpdateQueue.php:278

tests.evidence: change.diff is 742 lines with zero test files and no Pest/PHPUnit coverage for create/update/access/policy/call paths

review.summary: The change fully implements queue lifecycle, per-queue call grants, QueuePolicy, and both call-path authorizations with docs in sync. It cannot be approved as-is because it ships no tests despite the project requiring test-first coverage for every feature.
